corrections.basis: Chapter 18C Pre-Commercial Company: single 24-month disposal undertaking under Rules 10.07 and 18C.13 replaces the standard six-month 10.07(1)(a) undertaking. Commences on the prospectus shareholding-disclosure date (inclusive of Listing Date) and ends 'on the date which is 24 months from the Listing Date' (inclusive end ON the anniversary), so first free day = anniversary + 1 = 2028-01-10.
